 Oral Order
(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) Matter called twice.
There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
Even on the earlier two dates of hearing, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner and in the order sheet of the Trial Court, the same has been taken note of.
Under the circumstances, this Court has no other option to dismiss the petition for non prosecution.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed for non prosecution.
